English Literature.question: ১) ''There are more things in heaven and earth, Horatio, than are dreamt of in your philosophy.'' a quote of William Shakespeare which is taken from -
English Literature.exp:
"There are more things in heaven and earth, Horatio,
Than are dreamt of in your philosophy."
- uttered by Hamlet.

English Literature.question: ২) Which is the latest period of English literature?
English Literature.exp:
The Latest Period of English Literature is the Post-Modern period (1939-present).
Before this period, The Modern English period was the one of the most significant literary period.
The Modern Period (1901-1939) which is divided into two shorter periods.
One is The Edwardian Period (1901-1910) and the other is The Georgian Period (1910-1939).
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question:
৩) ''Her lips were red, her looks were free,
Her locks were yellow as gold:
Her skin was as white as leprosy''
- These lines are taken from the poem of -
English Literature.exp:
"Her lips were red, her looks were free,
Her locks were yellow as gold:
Her skin was as white as leprosy,
The Night-mare LIFE-IN-DEATH was she,
Who thicks man's blood with cold."

- The Rime of the Ancient Mariner
by S. T Coleridge.

English Literature.question: ৪) 'Shylock' is an important character of -
English Literature.exp:
The Merchant of Venice, comedy in five acts by William Shakespeare, written about 1596–97 and printed in a quarto edition in 1600.
The important characters of this play are:
Shylock, Portia, Antonio, Bassanio, Jessica etc.
Source: Britannica.com

English Literature.question: ৫) A lyric poem mourning for the death of an individual or lamenting over a tragic event is called-
English Literature.exp:
Elegy is a Lyric poem mourning for the death of an individual or lamenting over a tragic event.
Tragedy is a form of drama which presents the fall of a superior human being for a mistake of some kind.
Ode is an exalted lyric poem that begins with an address to someone, instil anguish in the middle part and ends with consolation.
Lyric is a short poem expressing personal or subjective thoughts and intense feelings of a single speaker. It is identical to a song sung with a lyre.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ৬) ''Revenge is a kind of wild justice'' who said that?
English Literature.exp:
Francis Bacon is The Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose. His famous quotations are-
'Old wood best to burns, old wine to drink, old friends to trust and old author to read',
'Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed and some few to be chewed and digested.',
'A mixture of lie doth ever add pleasure',
'Silence is the sleep that nourishes wisdom',
'Revenge is a kind of wild justice',
'Unmarried men are best friends, best Masters, best servants but not always best subjects',
'Opportunity makes a thief',
'It is impossible to love and be wise',
'History makes man wise'.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৭) Which time frame known as 'The Renaissance Period'?
English Literature.exp:
In English literature 1500 - 1660 is the time frame which known as The Renaissance Period. It is divided into four main period.
1. Elizabethan Period (1558-1603),
2. Jacobean Period (1603-1625),
3. Caroline Period (1625-1649) and
4. Commonwealth Period (1649-1660).
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ৮) 'The woods are lovely, dark and deep' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp:
Robert Frost is an American national poet. His famous poem is 'Stopping by woods on a snowy evening'. Famous quotation of this poem is-
''The woods are lovely, dark and deep, But I have promises to keep, And miles to go before I sleep, And miles to go before I sleep.''
'Good fences make good neighbors' (Mending Wall).
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৯) Which one is an important character of Hamlet?
English Literature.exp:
Hamlet, in full Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, tragedy in five acts by William Shakespeare, written about 1599–1601 and published in a quarto edition in 1603.
Important characters of this play are:
Hamlet, Ophelia, Claudius, Gertrude, Horatio, Polonius etc.
Source: Britannica.com

English Literature.question: ১০) A narrative poem that tells a story through dialogue and action is called-
English Literature.exp:
Ballad is a narrative poem that tells a story through dialogue and action.
Ode is an exalted lyric poem that begins with an address to someone, instil anguish in the middle part and ends with consolation.
Elegy is a Lyric poem mourning for the death of an individual or lamenting over a tragic event.
Epic is a long narrative poem that tells in grand style the history and aspirations of a national hero.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ১১) 'Childhood shows the man as morning shows the day' a famous quote of -
English Literature.exp:
John Milton is a great Master of verse in the puritan period. He is an Epic poet in English literature. His famous quotations are
'Childhood shows the man as morning shows the day',
'It is better to reign in hell than to serve in heaven'
'Love quarrels of in pleasing Concord end.',
'Death is the golden key that opens the place of eternity'.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ১২) 'The Romantic Period' belongs to -
English Literature.option1: ক) The second half of 18th century
English Literature.option2: খ) The first half of 19th century
English Literature.option3: গ) The second half of 19th century
English Literature.option4: ঘ) The first half of 18th century
English Literature.exp:
The Romantic Period of English Literature is 1798 to 1832; which means it belongs to the First half of 19th century.
The Victorian Period is 1832-1901; which belongs to 19 century.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ১৩) 'Ten thousand saw I at a glance' is an example of-
English Literature.exp:
Hyperbole is an exaggerated statement or an extreme overstatement.
Example of hyperbole is, 'Ten thousand saw I at a glance' (The Daffodils, William Wordsworth).
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman

English Literature.question: ১৪) Who is the heroine of The Rape of the Lock?
English Literature.exp:
Alexander Pope is the poet of Augusta Period. His famous epic is The Rape of the Lock.
The important character of this Epic is Baron (Hero), Belinda (Heroine), Arial (God).
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ১৫) A statement which actually means the opposite of its surface meaning is called-
English Literature.exp:
Statement which actually means the opposite of its surface meaning is called Irony.
The first sentence of Pride and Prejudice is an example of irony: ''It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.''
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ১৬) 'The course of true love never did run smooth' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp:
Mid Summer Night's Dream is a comedy of William Shakespeare. Famous quotations of this comedy are-
-The course of true love never did run smooth.
-Love looks not with the eyes but with the mind.

English Literature.question: ১৭) Which time frame known as 'The Age of Chaucer'?
English Literature.exp:
The Middle English period (1066-1500) divided into 3 parts. They are -
1. The Anglo-norman Period (1066-1340)
2. The Age of Chaucer (1340-1400) and
3. The Dark/Barren period (1400-1485/1500).
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ১৮) 'A figure of speech which stands for a pleasant way of referring to something unpleasant' is called-
English Literature.exp:
Euphemism is a figure of speech which stands for a pleasant way of referring to something unpleasant.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ১৯) The character 'Desdemona' is created by Shakespeare in-
English Literature.exp:
Othello is a famous Tragedy of William Shakespeare.
The important character of Othello are - Othello, Desdemona, Brabantio, Iago, Cassio, Emilia etc.
Source: Britannica.com.

English Literature.question: ২০) ______ is a literary form in which one story is told in the guise of another story.
English Literature.exp:
Allegory হচ্ছে যেখানে রূপক বা প্রতীকাশ্রয়ী কাহিনীর মাধ্যমে কোন কিছুর বর্ণনা করা হয়।
A Story or picture with two or more different meanings- a literal meaning and one or more symbolic meanings. The setting, characters, and things that happen inside an allegory are symbols for ideas and qualities.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ২১) 'The Restoration Period' in English Literature refers to-
English Literature.exp:
The Neo-classical period is divided into 3 short period. Such as
1. The Restoration Period (1660-1700),
2. The Augustan Age or the Age of Pope (1700-1745) and
3. The Age of Sensibility or The Age of Johnson (1745-1798).
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ২২) 'Man's love is of man's life a part; it is a woman's whole existence.' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp:
Lord Byron is the rebel poet of English literature. His famous quotations are
- Man's love is of man's life a thing apart, it is women's whole existence.
- Men's conscience is the Oracle of God,
- Revenge is sweet especially to women.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ২৩) The character 'Friday' is created by-
English Literature.exp:
Robinson Crusoe is a famous novel written by Daniel Defoe. The important character of this novel is Robinson Crusoe, Friday, Xury, The Spaniard, The Portuguese Captain.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ২৪) 'Cowards die many times before their death' is a quote of William Shakespeare which is taken from-
English Literature.exp:
Julius Caesar is a famous tragedy of William Shakespeare. The important quotations of this tragedy are
'Cowards die many times before their death',
'Veni, Vidi, Vici (I came, I saw, I conquered',
'Brutus, you too!'.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ২৫) _____ is a kind of drama that provides sensational entertainment.
English Literature.exp:
Melodrama a kind of drama that provides sensational entertainment.
Comedy is a kind of drama which begins with adversity or discord but ends in happiness.
Tragedy is a form of drama which presents the fall of a superior human being for a mistake of some kind.
Tragicomedy is a kind of play in which tragic and comic scenes are mingled.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ২৬) Which time frame is known as The Victorian Period of English literature?
English Literature.exp:
The Victorian Period of English literature is '1832-1900'. The Romantic Period of English literature is '1798-1832'.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ২৭) Who said, 'Popular opinion is the greatest lie'?
English Literature.exp:
Thomas Carlyle was a Scottish philosopher. His famous quotations are -
-Popular opinion is the greatest lie.
-Speech is great, silence is greater.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ২৮) 'Heathcliff' is the central character of-
English Literature.exp:
Wuthering Heights is a famous novel written by Emily Bronte.
The important character of this novel is Heathcliff, Lockwood, Catherine Earnshaw, Cathy Linton, Edgar Linton etc.
Source: Britannica.com

English Literature.question: ২৯) 'Full many a flower is born to blush unseen, And waste its sweetness on the desert air' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp:
Thomas Gray is known as Graveyard poet. His famous quotations are-
'Full many a flower is born to blush unseen, And waste its sweetness on the desert air',
'Where ignorance is bliss, it is folly to be wise',
'The paths of glory lead but to grave'.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৩০) A form of drama which presents the fall of a superior human being for a mistake of some kind known as-
English Literature.exp:
Tragedy is a form of drama which presents the fall of a superior human being for a mistake of some kind. Comedy is a kind of drama which begins with adversity or discord but ends in happiness. Elegy is a Lyric poem mourning for the death of an individual or lamenting over a tragic event. Ode is an exalted lyric poem that begins with an address to someone, instil anguish in the middle part and ends with consolation.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ৩১) Which is the longest period in English Literature?
English Literature.exp:
The Longest Period of English Literature is The Anglo-Saxon Period. It started in 450 and ended in 1066; which the duration of this Period was 616 years.
The Anglo-Norman Period is 1066-1340.
The Renaissance Period is 1500-1660.
The Middle English Period is 1066-1500.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৩২) 'To be or not to be that is the question' is the beginning of a famous soliloquy of-
English Literature.exp:
Hamlet is a famous tragedy of William Shakespeare. Famous quotations of Hamlet-
'To be or not to be that is the question',
'Frailty, thy name is woman',
Brevity is the soul of wit',
Neither a borrower nor a lender be; For loan off loses both itself and friend',
'There is divinity that shapes our end',
''There are many things in Heaven and Earth, Horatio, than are dreamt of in your philosophy.''
''I must be cruel, only to be kind: thus, bad begins and worse remains behind.''
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৩৩) 'Laputans' is a character in-
English Literature.exp:
Gulliver's Travel is a fiction written by Jonathan Swift. The important character of this fiction is Gulliver, Laputans, Lilliputians, Houyhnhnms, Blefuscudian etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৩৪) Who is the author of 'Beware of false knowledge; it is more dangerous than ignorance.'?
English Literature.exp:
G. B. Shaw is a greatest Dramatist of modern English literature. Important quotation of GB Shaw is
'Beware of false knowledge; it is more dangerous than ignorance',
'There is no love sincerer than the love of food',
'There are two tragedies in life. One is not to get your heart's desire. The other is to get it.
'It is our duty to live as long as we can',
'Nine shoulders out of ten are born fools',
'God is on the side of big battalions'.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৩৫) 'And Joy, whose hand is ever at his lips Bidding adieu' is an example of-
English Literature.exp:
A figure of speech in which lifeless objects or ideas are given imaginary life known as Personification. Examples- ''And Joy, whose hand is ever at his lips Bidding adieu'' here 'Joy' has been imagined as a living person.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ৩৬) Which time frame is called 'The Age of Shakespeare'?
English Literature.exp:
The Renaissance Period (1500-1660) is divided into four main Period. Such as-
1. Elizabethan Period (1558-1603),
2. Jacobean Period (1603-1625),
3. Caroline Period (1625-1649) and
4. Commonwealth Period (1649-1660).
Here, 'The Puritan Age' is refer to (1620-1660) and The Age of Shakespeare is 1590-1616.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৩৭) 'If Winter comes, Can spring be far behind?' a quotation of -
English Literature.exp:
PB Shelley is a famous Romantic poet. His famous quotations are
'If Winter comes can spring be far behind?',
'The more we study, the more we discover our ignorance',
'Fear not the future, weep not for the past',
'Our sweetest songs are those that tell of saddest thought',
'Poets are the unacknowledged legislators of the world',
'I am the daughter of Earth and Water; And the nursling of the sky'.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৩৮) 'Albatross' is a character of-
English Literature.option1: ক) The Rime of the Ancient Mariner
English Literature.option3: গ) The Return of the Native
English Literature.exp:
The Rime of the Ancient Mariner is a literary work of Samuel Taylor Coleridge.
The important characters of this work are: The Mariner, Wedding Guest, Albatross, The Nightmare, Life in Death.
Source: Britannica.com

English Literature.question: ৩৯) 'Charms strike the sight but merit strikes the heart' was quoted by-
English Literature.exp:
Alexander Pope is a Mock Heroic Poet. His famous quotations are
'Charms strike the sight but merit strikes the heart',
'A little learning is a dangerous thing',
'To err is human, nto forgive is divine', '
An honest man is the noblest work of God',
'The proper study of mankind is man',
'Fools rush in where angles fear to tread',
'Hope springs eternal in the human breast'.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৪০) An explicit comparison between two different things is called-
English Literature.exp:
Simile is an explicit comparison between two different things. Usually 'as' and 'like' are used in Simile. Metaphor is an implicit comparison between two different things.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ৪১) 'The Dark Period' of English literature is-
English Literature.exp:
The Middle English Period (1066-1500) is divided into 3 short period. Such as-
1. The Anglo Norman Period (1066-1340),
2. The Age of Chaucer' (1340-1400) and
3. The Dark/Barren Period (1400-1485/1500).
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৪২) 'Poetry is a spontaneous overflow of powerful feelings' told by -
English Literature.exp:
William Wordsworth is a famous Romantic poet. His famous quotations are
'Poetry is a spontaneous overflow of powerful feelings'
'Ten thousand saw at a glance Tossing their heads in sprightly lance',
'Child is the father of man',
'Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting',
'Nature never did betray the heart that loved her',
'Poet is the breath and final speed of knowledge',
'Come forth into the light of things, let nature be your teacher'.
source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৪৩) The character 'Mosca' is created by Ben Jonson in-
English Literature.exp:
Volpone, The Silent Woman (or Epicoene), The Alchemist etc are the famous play of Ben Jonson. The important character of Volpone is Mosca, Celia, Bonario, Corvino, Volpone, Voltore.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৪৪) Who quoted 'Sorrows are the best educator'?
English Literature.exp:
Alfred Tennyson is a famous Victorian poet. His famous quotations are
-Knowledge comes but wisdom lingers. -Sorrows are the best educator.
-The old order changeth yielding place to new.
-Authority forgets a dying king.
-Who are wise in love, love most, say least.
-I will never rest from travels, I will drink life to the lees.

English Literature.question: ৪৫) An implicit or indirect reference to another work of literature, a historical or mythical person or event known as-
English Literature.exp:
Allusion is an implicit or indirect reference to another work of literature, a historical or mythical person or event.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

English Literature.question: ৪৬) 'The Elizabethan Period' refers to -
English Literature.exp:
The Renaissance period (1500-1660) is divided into 4 main period. These are:
1. The Elizabethan period (1558-1603)
2. The Jacobean period (1603-1625)
3. The Caroline period (1625-1649) and
4. The Commonwealth period (1649-1660).
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৪৭) 'All the world's a stage and all the men and women are merely players.' a famous quotation of William Shakespeare which is taken from-
English Literature.exp:
'As You Like It' is a famous comedy of William Shakespeare. The important questions of this comedy are-
'All the world's a stage and all the men and women are merely players.'
'Sweet are the uses of adversity'
'Under the greenwood tree who loves to die with me, and turn his merry note.'
source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৪৮) 'Mephistopheles' is the important character of-
English Literature.exp:
Doctor Faustus is a famous Tragedy (Morality play) of Christopher Marlowe. The important character of this Tragedy is Mephistophilis, Lucifer, Faustus, Cornelius, Good Angel, Bad angel etc.
source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Literature.question: ৪৯) 'If you want to shine like a sun, first burn like a sun.' quoted by -
English Literature.exp:
APJ Abdul Kalam was a former president of India. His famous quotations are-
''If you want to shine like a sun, first burn like a sun.'',
''Dream is not that which you see while sleeping; It is something that will not let you sleep''.

English Literature.question: ৫০) 'Blank Verse' is a kind of verse-
English Literature.exp:
A Blank Verse is a poem with no rhyme at the end but does have iambic pentameter. An iambic pentameter line is a verse line of five iambic feet. In blank verse, the last word of a line does not rhyme with the last word of any of the successive lines.
source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.
